verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev provides separate environments: a local dev server that executes tasks on your machine, preview branches, environment-scoped secret keys, and deploys to different environments. Community users specifically praise Dev mode for safe testing and iteration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that data, secrets and env vars are isolated between environments, and detail on how AI agents (e.g. via MCP) are kept scoped to non-production environments.
